about: What's New lines for the Settings panel, newest first. Add or remove lines with the 'Add What's New line' form: GitHub > Actions > Add What's New line > Run workflow.

items.text: New Settings panel: tap the gear at the end of the tab bar for About, privacy, help and more.
Systems check (Settings › About & help) shows how fresh each piece of data on the page is.
Storm Reports can remember your name and parish on this device.
Installed app: choose which page it opens on (Settings › App).
The Live Ops wind card now uses real Jersey Airport gusts for the last 12 hours.
Latest alerts sent: read an alert again after swiping the notification away.
Channel Islands Wind Tracker by VeryWeather added to Live Ops.
Warning alerts: a notification when Jersey Met issues or upgrades a warning.
Storm Scenarios opened to everyone, and the site moved to jerseyweatherchat.com.
